_about: The Marble Spins Championship video series (Moses, 28 Nov 2026): 10 races, one per series, 10 episodes stitched later into one YouTube video. The 20 racers are made-up usernames (racers.json), shown above their marbles; never claimed to be real people, no prize. Points per place 10-8-6-5-4-3-2-1 for places 1 to 8. Live tracks only. Looks only: the races are the game's own for each seed.
